topic: Ancient Grass redesign promoted to master and production
currentUserGoal: Move the approved redesign branch onto the repository default branch and make the Ancient Grass alpha publicly playable on the live domain.

release.gameCodeCommitMessage: Make Ancient Grass alpha the default

workCompleted: Added a pure route resolver and made the bare production URL launch the public Ancient Grass alpha.
Kept ?alpha as a stable public alias and kept ?redesign / ?newRun as internal redesign routes with public-alpha controls disabled.
Kept existing legacy ?perf, ?perfHarness, ?stress, ?hazardHarness, ?fieldShape, and ?mobileTest routes selecting the previous game automatically.
Added focused tests for default, alpha, developer, legacy, harness, and conflicting route parameters.
Fast-forwarded master from 29f83ac to 1ddd9fe and pushed it to origin/master.
Deployed the linked Sensitech Vercel project to production and confirmed all production aliases.
Left the live alpha open in the in-app browser for the user's next playtest.
verificationRun: Final npm run check passed before promotion: ESLint, 68 Vitest tests across seven files, TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Local bare-route browser smoke reported the Ancient Grass Alpha Test title, redesign/public-alpha classes, no public playtest controls, and a ready agent-readable root control.
Local ?legacy smoke reported the old Grass Touching Simulator title, a legacy canvas, and no redesign/public-alpha classes.
The custom domain returned HTTP 200 after aliasing.
Live bare-route browser smoke reached grassAgentDom ready, reported Playtest off, exposed only public controls, and logged no browser errors.
Live ?legacy browser smoke loaded the previous game and logged no browser errors.

deployment.notes: Two ordinary source uploads reached Vercel but failed at the remote file-list/build handoff with a generic service error. The authenticated archive upload bypassed that failure and deployed successfully.

currentGitStatus: Expected after committing and pushing this release handoff: clean master aligned with origin/master.
The production game code is commit 1ddd9fe; the later handoff-only commit does not change the deployed application bundle.
knownIssues: Redesign persistence still stores permanent memory only; refreshing during an active run starts a fresh run.
A fresh narrow-phone production screenshot remains outstanding even though responsive Field Kit placement has pure tests.
The Open Graph preview still represents the previous game and should be replaced before a wider Discord announcement.
The successful Vercel archive was 82.3 MB because deployment ignores have not yet been tuned for large docs/artifacts; add a careful .vercelignore before routine releases.
Normal Vercel source deployment hit a transient remote service error twice. Use the archive command above if the same failure recurs.
nextRecommendedSteps: Have the user and first Discord cohort play the live root naturally and collect only alpha-blocking feedback first.
Add an Ancient Grass/Scourge Open Graph image and metadata before broad link sharing.
Test one narrow phone viewport against production, especially the left Field Kit rail and Memory Grove.
Decide whether active-run persistence is required for the next alpha checkpoint.
Add a conservative .vercelignore that excludes docs artifacts and machine-local output without excluding runtime public assets.
doNotRevert: Keep the redesign alpha as the bare production route and continue calling it alpha, not beta.
Keep ?legacy as the explicit previous-game fallback.
Keep legacy performance/stress harness query routes selecting the previous game until equivalent redesign harnesses exist.
Keep internal redesign playtest controls out of the public root and ?alpha alias.
Keep the left vertical numbered Field Kit and 1-7 keyboard controls from the preceding release slice.
